locations.name: Thornwick
locations.description:
A sleepy farming village gathered around an old stone well. The townsfolk are friendly, if a little wary of strangers since the livestock started going missing.

locations.name: The Gilded Flagon
locations.description: A rowdy roadside inn run by a retired adventurer. Rooms are two silver a night; rumours are free if you buy a round.

locations.name: Spire of Aldren
locations.description: A lone wizard's tower. A violet crystal turns slowly above its roof, and the door has no handle on the outside.

locations.name: Ruins of Kael'dor
locations.description: Moss-covered columns of a temple that predates the kingdom. Scholars argue about which god it was built for. Nobody argues about the noises at night.

locations.name: Rotfang Cave
locations.description: Torches burn outside a cave in the foothills. Goblin tracks lead in. Few lead out.

locations.name: Ranger Camp
locations.description: The Wardens of the Greenwood keep a small camp here. They trade maps and news for supplies.

locations.name: The Whispering Stones
locations.description: A ring of standing stones around an altar. On a still night you can hear voices between the stones.

locations.name: Greywatch Keep
locations.description: Seat of Lord Varric, protector of the valley. The garrison is stretched thin and the lord is hiring capable swords.
